text: スロットの　えがらを　よおく　みて　ボタンを　おすのが　コツだよ

structure.jp: スロットの　えがらを　よおく　みて
structure.en: watch the slot's pictures really closely and

structure.jp: ボタンを　おすのが

patterns.name: 〜の (nominalizer)
patterns.span: ボタンを　おすのが
patterns.explanation: の after a verb turns the whole action into a thing you can talk about. ボタンを　おすのが = 'pressing the button is'.

patterns.name: 〜て (linking)
patterns.explanation: The て-form joins two actions in order: do this, then that. よおく　みて　ボタンを　おす = 'look closely and then press the button'.
